decisions.reason: Garage door operators build on existing door systems and can be improved through the firm's R&D and automation partnerships.
Solid wood sectional doors require woodworking expertise outside the firm's fabricated-metal knowledge, limiting its capacity to interpret results and improve the product.
Remote-control operators are a natural extension of the operator line and leverage the same electromechanical knowledge.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are incremental variants of the firm's core industrial door products.
Insulated glazed doors combine existing thermal and sectional door expertise, making assimilation straightforward.
This glazed industrial door variant is closely aligned with the firm's established metal door capabilities.
